_about: Evidence-status rules for hadith citations (plan item 13). The tool applies these rules mechanically; it never weighs one scholar against another. The Sharia reviewer writes, signs and dates this file. Until she signs, the rules below are the team's draft and the interface says so.

coverage._about: Plan item 12: a grading counts only for the wording it was said of.
coverage.longer_when: the narration has more than twice the quote's words and at least 8 more

supported.when: Found in the two Sahihs (a longer narration there counts, since it contains the quoted words), or every grading of this wording by the approved scholars that Dorar returned is in an accepted category.

not_supported.en: Not supported by the approved sources
not_supported.when: Every grading of this wording by the approved scholars is weak, very weak or fabricated. Red only when one of them is fabricated or baseless. A grading of a longer narration that contains the quote is shown but not counted.

verify.when: The gradings differ, the wording differs (words of the quote missing from the narration), only longer narrations containing the quote were graded, a fabricated grading meets a Sahih narration, the written attribution is wrong, a grading speaks only about the chain, or the match was made by the model.

refer.when: Nothing was found, the source could not be reached, or the question asks for a fatwa.
